name: Global New Material International Holdings Limited
summary: Global New Material International Holdings Limited is an investment holding company, established in 2011 and headquartered in Liuzhou, that manufactures pearlescent pigments and sells them across China, Asia, Europe, Africa and South America under the Chesir Pearl brand. The pigments use natural or synthetic mica, glass flakes or silicon oxide. It also supplies synthetic mica powder, and its customers include automotive coatings, cosmetics, plastics, printing, textile and ceramics makers.
